statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-46680 (GO-2026-5378, GHSA-fqw6-gf59-qr4w): containerd treated a numeric image User value that does not parse as a 32-bit integer as a user name, so a crafted image whose /etc/passwd maps that string to root ran as UID 0, bypassing the Kubernetes runAsNonRoot restriction. github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 is affected from v2.0.4 before v2.0.9, from v2.1.0-beta.0 before v2.2.4 and from v2.3.0-beta.0 before v2.3.1: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-fqw6-gf59-qr4w, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5378. Read the Go build information of every executable in every published build-dev package for Alpine 3.23 (2.6.4-r0 to 2.28.0-r5, 86 versions, x86_64 and aarch64; 2.6.4-r0 is published for aarch64 only); each holds one executable, the Go program /usr/bin/build, with the same Go version and module versions as the build package of that version. Every build before 2.17.3-r0 links github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 v2.2.0, v2.2.1 or v2.2.3, inside the affected range; 2.17.3-r0 and every later build link v2.2.4, v2.2.5 or v2.3.2 to v2.3.6, which carry the fix. No build links the v1 module github.com/containerd/containerd. 2.19.1-r1 is listed three times in the package index under one version; the copy the repository serves was read.

CVE-2026-46680: containerd treats an unparseable numeric user as a user name, which lets a container evade runAsNonRoot; github.com/containerd/containerd 1.7.27 to 1.7.31 is affected (fixed in 1.7.32), and containerd/v2 is fixed in 2.0.9, 2.2.4 and 2.3.1 (https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-fqw6-gf59-qr4w, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5378). The Go build information of /usr/bin/trivy in each of the 37 published trivy-dev builds for Alpine 3.23 (0.69.1-r0 to 0.74.0-r11), on both x86_64 and aarch64, was read for this decision. Builds before 0.70.0-r5 embed github.com/containerd/containerd 1.7.29 to 1.7.30 and github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 2.2.0 to 2.2.2, which the advisory lists as affected. Builds from 0.70.0-r5 on embed github.com/containerd/containerd 1.7.32 (in some of them) and github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 2.2.4 to 2.3.6, which the advisory does not list as affected.
